name: hud_sensor_tracker_apply_mission_data_and_reload
description: HudSensorTracker::ApplyMissionDataAndReload applies restored Mission section data, requests deferred stop for first mission load, and restores mission/objective runtime state. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation and disassembly at 0x4174f0 show skipTimerResetOnStart, completed count and difficulty stores, an early first-load InitMissionIdAndFlags plus ZAR_RequestStopGlobal path, a mission-id-change reload path, and final restoration of objective counters, mission stats, weapons mask, and ten objective completed flags.
Direct callees are dependency-ready and functional-equivalent/provider-accepted for this use.
The native apply-mission-data smoke verifies the first-load stop path and the same-mission restore path, including callback forwarding through ZarMission_RestoreCallback.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x4174f0 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
